_comment: Row 300 identity/claim battery. Re-run from a detached standalone scratch copy with toolchain/bin/bd-mutate --spec tests/mutants/row300_display_test_ownership.json --work DETACHED_SCRATCH. M1 removes the atomic O_EXCL display claim and M2 disables owned teardown. The separate foreign-cleanup spec restores the historical fixed-lock bare-PID kill against only its sacrificial catcher, so that destructive mutant never runs unrelated display tests.
subject: the behavioral display test atomically claims its display and still terminates the non-reusable process identity it started

mutants.label: M1 remove O_EXCL so a competing display claim can be acquired
M2 suppress pidfd signaling so the owned display leaks
